runtime_overlay.application: Install numpy==2.3.5 with --no-deps after uv sync --frozen; preserve the original Isaac Lab lock bytes and use this same overlay for the allocation and both FlashSAC recipes.

schedule.balanced: Each recipe occupies each within-seed position twice; each directed within-seed immediate predecessor occurs twice. Official/native for seeds0,2; native/official for1,3.
schedule.limitation: Cross-seed boundary transitions and process cache histories are not balanced. All startup/compilation costs and chronological order are retained.

scope: Four seeds on one GPU allocation; prior A/B results are historical context, not pooled replication.

figures.name: quality-transitions
figures.title: FlashSAC quality over the extended, fixed budget
figures.caption: Every faint curve is one seed; solid lines are means and shading is observed min/max, not a confidence interval. In the transition plot, the dotted marker is the old 400-iteration budget. Wall curves use actual portable checkpoint write-finished times; mean lines use mean times.

figures.name: quality-training_process_seconds
figures.title: FlashSAC quality over the extended, fixed budget
figures.caption: Every faint curve is one seed; solid lines are means and shading is observed min/max, not a confidence interval. In the transition plot, the dotted marker is the old 400-iteration budget. Wall curves use actual portable checkpoint write-finished times; mean lines use mean times.

figures.name: historical-duration-quality
figures.title: Prior 400-iteration results and fresh 400/2000 checkpoints
figures.caption: Dots retain all four seeds; horizontal marks and whiskers show mean and observed min/max. Prior A/B are unchanged historical results. Only the fresh 400 and 2,000 columns follow the same new learning trajectories; old/new GPU load, caches and stochastic trajectories can differ.

figures.name: execution-wall
figures.title: Complete execution cost, independent of balancing success
figures.caption: Bars are seed means; whiskers are min/max complete run wall. Replay export/checkpoint/logging costs are inside the loop and process, not added again. Compilation and startup are included; installation/upload are excluded. These are chronological shared-cache costs, not isolated cold-start trials.

figures.name: threshold-intervals
figures.title: Time to balancing is interval censored, never interpolated
figures.caption: Intervals end at the first observed passing policy. Right triangles are failures to reach the gate by 2,000, not fast successes. Quality is evaluated offline from saved checkpoints; these clocks are not online success-detection latency.
